The characters' different priorities remain visible, and the chapter ends with continuity as accountable change.

Deliberately concise transition into Chapter XXXII. All figures are male.

legacy_unverified_chapters.title: The Country Without a Name
legacy_unverified_chapters.source_heading: Chapter XXXII: The Country Without a Name
legacy_unverified_chapters.notes: Expanded and verified at 1,476 words. The unnamed country becomes a changing geography navigated through the bell, maps, and material records. The Digitorium is developed as a male civic archive with distinct approaches to provenance and interpretation. Removed the prior female and child figures; Ansel is introduced here and his later entrance in Chapter XXXIII is reconciled. Deliberately concise transition into the upper chamber.

legacy_unverified_chapters.title: The Men Who Arrived First
legacy_unverified_chapters.source_heading: Chapter XXXIII: The Men Who Arrived First
legacy_unverified_chapters.notes: Expanded and verified against Chapters XXXII and XXXIV. Ansel leads the travelers into the chamber of the first arrivals. The six men have distinct accounts of the earlier world's mistakes; the empty seventh chair remains unclaimed, and the central space is understood as a relation rather than a seat. The travelers cross toward the City Beneath the Forest without trying to be first. All cast members are male.

legacy_unverified_chapters.title: The City Beneath the Forest
legacy_unverified_chapters.source_heading: Chapter XXXIV: The City Beneath the Forest
legacy_unverified_chapters.notes: Expanded and verified against Chapters XXXIII and XXXV. The organism notices the travelers and begins to form a word. All cast members are male.

legacy_unverified_chapters.title: The First Test
legacy_unverified_chapters.source_heading: Chapter XXXV: The First Test
legacy_unverified_chapters.notes: Expanded and verified at 1,206 words. The organism's first test separates the men's memories of one another without physically separating them. Each man recovers a distinct anchor: Tyler's room and record, Luke's box, Kirk's chair, Bill's table, the largest man's tree, the Seventh Man's road, and Joseph and the Teller's chosen contact. The city returns without making their memories identical; 'Continuance' names the principle. All cast members are male.

legacy_unverified_chapters.title: The House Remembers the Other Side
legacy_unverified_chapters.source_heading: Chapter XXXVI: The House Remembers the Other Side
legacy_unverified_chapters.notes: Expanded and verified at 1,055 words. The seventh chair's unnamed occupant remains unresolved while the House and the country become mutually visible. The House is shown as a living memory structure whose lines preserve the men's distinct relations, not a replacement image of the past. The Teller and Joseph retain their separate but shared history; Ansel keeps interpretation bounded. The bell sequence and waking organism lead directly into Chapter XXXVII. All figures are male.

legacy_unverified_chapters.title: The Waking Country
legacy_unverified_chapters.source_heading: Chapter XXXVII: The Waking Country
legacy_unverified_chapters.notes: Expanded and verified against Chapters XXXVI and XXXVIII. The first room appears on the Digitorium screens, and Joseph distinguishes remembering the organism from being remembered by it. 'Continuance' becomes clear. All cast members are male.

legacy_unverified_chapters.title: The Archive Beneath the Skin

The existing husband line is preserved. Replaced the child reference with adult male apprentices; the blank regions remain unresolved. All cast members are male.

legacy_unverified_chapters.title: The Seventh Man

All cast members are male.

legacy_unverified_chapters.title: The Eighth Note

legacy_unverified_chapters.title: The Man Who Refused the Name

legacy_unverified_chapters.notes: Expanded and verified at 764 words. The men refuse to turn 'Don't remember me' into a puzzle or demand. The duplicate screw is shown as a copy without the relation that made the original useful. All figures are male.

All figures are male.

legacy_unverified_chapters.title: The Room of the Men

All cast members are male.

legacy_unverified_chapters.title: The Sentence Walks

The four men's contributions become usable places rather than named monuments: Joseph leaves waiting, Tyler a reciprocal doorway, Kirk a division that preserves distinction, and Luke an open distance. The first page retains their history, the second records the world's independent activity, and the third remains genuinely unwritten. Checked against Chapters LVI and LVIII–LX; no later mystery is resolved. All four principal characters remain male and distinct.

legacy_unverified_chapters.title: The Man Upstairs

legacy_unverified_chapters.title: The First Stop

Adds Mang0 and Arin as occasional commentators on the unexplained chair scrape, without displacing Seth and Nick's main broadcast. Preserves the twelve positions, intentional absence, the stranger's account, Bill's distinction between connection and relation, the inscription, and the open door.
